Commentary.Commentary: 278 is the target then for England tonight to win the series. Looks a difficult one, on a turning track. That too, with Jason Roy not playing, the visitors have their hands full. Join us back at 1815 IST (1245 GMT) for the run chase.

The seam bowling was not at its best today. Chris Woakes had an off day while Liam Plunkett was ordinary. Ben Stokes is still not back to full fitness hence perhaps he did not bowl his full quota of 10 overs while strangely, Jake Ball bowled only 8 overs.

England will be disappointed with both, their team selection and their bowling on this pitch. It is turning and they should have picked Liam Dawson in place of Liam Plunkett. The spin duo of Moeen Ali and Adil Rashid went for just 85 in 20 overs combined and also picked up 5 wickets between them.

Sabbir Rahman and Mushfiqur Rahim steadied the innings with a 54-run stand but the former's wicket led to another collapse before Rahim set the stage on fire towards the end. He found an able partner in Mosaddek Hossain as the duo added an unbeaten 85 in 71 balls for the 7th wicket.

That is a handy total on a slow, turning pitch by Bangladesh. The batting was a really good effort with the openers taking their time to settle but not throwing it away. However, once the opening stand was dislodged, there was a bit of a collapse.
Full ball on off, Rahim plays it through the point region. The fielder in the deep runs in from third man and stops the ball. Three runs taken. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 277/6!

Buttler collects the ball behind and tries to whip off the bails but even before that the ball pops out of his gloves and goes onto the stumps. There is an appeal for a stumping and the umpire takes ages to refer it upstairs. Replays show Shakib fails to come back and he has to depart. Bangladesh have lost half their side now. That's first wicket of the series for Moeen Ali!

It went straight to James Vince at short extra cover who made no mistake. So Tamim falls after a start again - 45 from 68 balls. Could have got more.

Back of a length ball on off, Tamim cuts it towards cover-point. Doesn't time it that well as the ball goes straight to the fielder there.
Fuller length ball outside off, Tamim drives it straight to the cover region.
Length delivery around off, Kayes taps it to the off side for a quick single.
Beaten! Length delivery outside off, Tamim fails to connect his bat on the ball.
Landed outside off, plays it to third man and takes a single.
Good length ball on off, Kayes tries to push it through the off side but gets a bottom edge to the leg side.
On middle and off, flicked away through the square leg region for a single.
Landed around off, Iqbal pushes it towards point.
WIDE! Touch fullish outside off, angling away, Iqbal leaves it alone. The umpire signals a wide. Looks a bit harsh though and Woakes is not impressed either.
Good length ball outside off, Tamim plays inside the line and lets it go through.

On the pads, Kayes looks to flick it across but misses and is hit on the pads. There is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire is not interested. Might be missing leg and it could be pitched outside leg too.
Fuller length ball on off, Kayes pushes it towards the mid off region.
On the pads, flicked away through backward square leg for a single.
Landed around off, Tamim flicks it to the leg side. The mid-wicket fielder goes to his left and stops the ball.
In the corridor outside off, Iqbal leaves it alone.
Good length ball on off, Tamim pushes it towards the point region but there is a fielder.
JAKE BALL to bowl from the other end.
Length ball on off, Kayes pushes it towards point.
EDGED! Outside off, Imrul tries to push but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards third man where the fielder cuts it off. Two runs taken.
FOUR! Landed outside off, Kayes lofts it over the cover region. The ball goes over the fielder and eventually goes past the rope. Kayes is off the mark with a boundary.
Another play and a miss! Good length ball around off, Kayes tries to push but fails to connect his bat on the ball yet again. This is good bowling!
BEATEN! Tad fuller outside off, Kayes gets onto his front foot to defend but the ball whizzes past his outside edge as he's beaten completely.
Starts off with a length ball on middle and leg, Iqbal tucks it through square leg for a single. Bangladesh are underway!
The players are out in the middle. There is an England team huddle. TAMIM IQBAL and IMRUL KAYES are the Bangladeshi openers. CHRIS WOAKES to bowl first up. Here we go!
Two changes for England, Jason Roy and David Willey are out, Sam Billings and Liam Plunkett come in. Bangladesh are unchanged!
ENGLAND WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BOWL!

Hello everyone to the third and final ODI between Bangladesh and England in Chittagong. It's a decider as the series is leveled 1-1 and you can't ask for anything more in this final clash. The hosts could have won the first game as well but failed to finish things off. However, they came back harder in the second one to level the series. It promises to be another interesting clash as Bangladesh are really strong at home now. The only concern is the weather as there is a rain predicton throughout and the toss was delayed a bit as it rained earlier as well. Let's hope the weather gods are kind enough and we get a result!
